terms.title: Terms & Privacy
terms.platformNatureDesc: Bharat Bachat is strictly a technology platform and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) product designed for digital record-keeping. We are NOT a bank, Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), lender, or payment aggregator.
terms.financialTxDesc: The App does not hold, transfer, disburse, or collect real money. All financial transactions, savings, and loans are conducted offline and independently by the users within their respective Self-Help Groups (Bachat Gats).
terms.disputeDesc: Bharat Bachat, its parent company, and its developers are not responsible for any financial disputes, defaults, or mismanagement of funds between group members.
terms.dataPrivacyDesc: We securely store your phone number and ledger data solely for the purpose of providing this service. We do not sell your personal data to third-party marketers.
terms.userRespDesc: By using this App, group administrators (Gat Pramukhs) take full responsibility for ensuring the accuracy of the data entered. Entering false records is strictly prohibited.

about.p1: Bharat Bachat is a secure digital ledger designed specifically for Self-Help Groups (Bachat Gats).
about.p2: Our mission is to replace easily-lost paper passbooks with a fully transparent, offline-capable mobile application. This ensures every member always knows exactly how much they have saved and what loans are active.
about.supportEmail: For any other queries, reach out to us at:

faq.q1: How do I create a new Gat?
faq.a1: Click on 'Create Gat' from the Home screen. Enter your group's name and the monthly contribution amount. You will automatically become the Admin.
faq.q2: How do I join an existing Gat?
faq.a2: Ask your Gat Pramukh for the 6-character Invite Code. Click 'Join Gat' and enter the code. You will be added once the Admin approves your request.
faq.a3: To maintain security, only the Gat Pramukh (Admin) can officially record deposits, withdrawals, and loan repayments.
faq.q4: How do I edit or cancel a mistake?
faq.a4: Admins can go to 'Group Details', scroll to 'Recent Transactions', and use the Pencil icon to edit, or the Trash icon to cancel (void) a record. Voided records remain visible for transparency.
faq.q5: How do I send a WhatsApp Receipt?
faq.a5: Under 'Recent Transactions' in your group, click the green 'Send Receipt' button under any transaction to instantly forward a digital receipt via WhatsApp.
faq.q6: How can I download my Passbook/Statement?
faq.a6: Go to 'My Profile' and click 'Download Complete Statement' to get a PDF of your personal records. Admins can download the full Group Ledger from the Passbook screen.
faq.a7: Yes! Your data is securely backed up to the cloud. Even if you lose your phone or have no internet, your records are completely safe.
faq.q8: How do I apply for a loan?
faq.a8: Go to 'Manage Loans' inside your group. Enter the principal amount, duration, and your proposed interest rate, then submit your request for the Admin to review.
